name: Colossus
description: A forty-metre giant walks down a city avenue, shaking cars and windows with every step.

wardrobe.man: a black leather jacket, a grey t-shirt, dark jeans and black boots
wardrobe.woman: a black leather jacket, a grey top, dark jeans and black boots
wardrobe.person: a black leather jacket, a grey top, dark jeans and black boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} appears in the new still as a colossal giant, the only giant in the scene, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The giant {subject} is about forty metres tall, mid-stride down the middle of a wide city avenue between glass and stone office towers, the head level with the twelfth-floor windows, wearing {wardrobe}. One boot is planted on the asphalt and is as long as a city bus; the knee reaches the fourth floor. Ordinary-sized cars and a city bus are stopped on the avenue around the feet, and a few tiny pedestrians stand on the sidewalks looking up. Extreme low-angle wide shot from street level among the stopped cars, looking up at the giant, the towers converging toward an overcast sky. Cinematic photography, overcast daylight, a light haze between the camera and the upper body that sells the scale. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the giant, blank facades and plain unbranded vehicles throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The giant {subject} is ALREADY walking down the avenue in slow, heavy, ground-shaking strides and keeps walking toward the camera for the whole shot, calm and unbothered, eyes scanning the rooftops ahead. Every time a boot lands the street shudders: the stopped cars bounce on their suspension, a shockwave of dust and loose debris ripples across the asphalt, windows rattle in their frames and a flock of pigeons bursts off a ledge. SCALE LOCK: the giant stays about forty metres tall in every frame, the boot as long as the bus beside it, the head level with the twelfth floor; a change of scale = failed take. The camera stays low at street level among the cars, shaking slightly on each impact, and tilts up slowly as the giant comes closer. Sound: deep booming footfalls with a sub-bass thud, car alarms going off one after another, rattling glass, distant cries of surprise. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, colossal scale and weight, sharp detail, stable picture.
